title: Neural-Hidden-CRF: A Robust Weakly-Supervised Sequence Labeler

contributions.claim: A neuralized undirected graphical model called Neural-Hidden-CRF for weakly-supervised sequence labeling.
A hidden CRF architecture that jointly models word sequences, latent ground-truth sequences, and weak-label sequences while capturing internal label dependencies.
Integration of BERT or other deep models to provide contextual semantic knowledge to the latent ground-truth sequence.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors describe Neural-Hidden-CRF as conceptually simple and empirically powerful.
The authors report new state-of-the-art results on one crowdsourcing benchmark and three weak-supervision benchmarks.
The authors report outperforming CHMM by 2.80 F1 points in average generalization performance and 2.23 F1 points in average inference performance.

narrative_sequence.summary: Introduces weakly-supervised sequence labeling as the target problem.
Defines a neuralized undirected graphical model with a hidden CRF layer and global modeling of observed, latent, and weak-label sequences.
Combines deep language-model representations with hidden-CRF modeling of contextual knowledge and label dependencies.
Reports strong empirical performance and benchmark results, including improvements over CHMM.
